uutiset.t: Core PCE Momentum Remained Elevated in October
uutiset.s: US consumer spending stalled in October after surging earlier in the year, suggesting households took a breather heading into the holiday season. Inflation-adjusted personal spending was little changed from a month earlier, according to Bureau of Economic Analysis data released Wednesday. Mike Reid,

uutiset.t: The RealReal CEO Sees Resale’s Structural Shift
uutiset.s: Data shows that consumer spending stalled in October. The RealReal CEO Rati Sahi Levesque joined Bloomberg Open Interest to talk about what she is seeing and how shoppers are turning to resale for value. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Europe Diesel Demand on Course to Fall Below Covid Levels
uutiset.s: Europe’s diesel demand is on course to be lower this year than during the Covid pandemic, a sign of how the Iran war is hitting oil consumption and squeezing consumers’ wallets.

White House economic adviser Kevin Hassett says strong investment and growth point to a “Goldilocks” economy, with inflation not accelerating. He also weighs in on Fed policy, Nvidia’s national importance, and the upcoming Lisa Cook hearing. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Dubai Bank Merger to Create $159 Billion Islamic Lending Giant
uutiset.s: Dubai Islamic Bank PJSC said it’s buying Emirates Islamic Bank PJSC in a deal that will create one of the world’s largest listed Islamic-banking groups, with assets of about $159 billion.

uutiset.t: DoubleLine’s Cohen Turns AI Debt Lover From Hater After Selloff
uutiset.s: AI debt has gotten cheap enough to tempt DoubleLine Capital’s Robert Cohen, who had warned of a potential bubble in the sector.

uutiset.t: Air India Chief Seeks to Cut $650 Million in Costs This Year
uutiset.s: Air India Ltd. is looking to cut costs by 60 billion rupees ($650 million) this financial year as its new Chief Executive Officer outlined initiatives to revive the Tata Group-owned airline, which posted a record loss in the year ended March, people familiar with the matter said.

uutiset.t: JPMorgan Backs Drone Engine Maker’s $10 Million Muni Bond Sale
uutiset.s: A drone engine manufacturer is making its debut in the US municipal bond market with a familiar name standing behind the debt: JPMorgan Chase & Co.

uutiset.t: Banks Pitch CVC €11 Billion Debt for Possible Verisure Deal
uutiset.s: Banks are offering CVC Capital Partners Plc up to €11 billion ($12 billion) in debt financing for a takeover of Verisure Plc, as the buyout firm weighs a bid to return the home security group to private ownership after a difficult year on the public markets.

uutiset.t: Homebuilder Stock Woes to Persist After Longest Slump Since 2008
uutiset.s: Homebuilders are coming up on an ominous market milestone, with stocks for the group set for three straight years of declines in the longest stretch since the subprime mortgage meltdown that led to the Global Financial Crisis.

uutiset.t: Nasdaq 100 Set for Bear Market as AI Trade Unravels at the Seams
uutiset.s: The Nasdaq 100 Index is set to fall into its first bear market in more than a year as investors dump stocks exposed to the artificial intelligence industry amid rapidly deteriorating sentiment.

uutiset.t: NYC Private School to Buy Farm Owned by Bankrupt Peer
uutiset.s: A private school on Manhattan’s Upper West Side is planning to purchase a 165-acre farm in the Catskills that was previously owned by its bankrupt peer.

uutiset.t: BC Partners Buys GSE Agency With Golfer DeChambeau on List
uutiset.s: BC Partners’ credit arm has agreed to buy a majority stake in GSE Worldwide, a sports marketing agency which represents athletes such as golf celebrity Bryson DeChambeau and former NFL and MLB star Bo Jackson.

uutiset.t: Nasdaq 100 Slumps in ‘Sell First’ Mode as AI Angst Fuels Losses
uutiset.s: The Nasdaq 100 Index tumbled for a second day, sending it briefly careening into bear-market territory, as mounting fears about over-investment in AI pummeled shares of the biggest technology companies.
